note: Now Bear Lake / Manistee KOA Holiday (formerly Kampvilla RV Park & Family Campground), family-owned, on 40 acres on Pleasanton Hwy (US-31) near Bear Lake: large grassy sites, tent sites in the woods, swimming pool, catch-and-release fishing pond. ~5 mi from the Lake Michigan shoreline (not on-water). --Claude

KOA: open May 1 - Oct 15, 50 A, full hookup and electric-only sites incl. pull-throughs, 100-ft max, Wi-Fi; one night $60.65 (May 2027 weekday, back-in electric only) to $84.34 (July 2027 Saturday). Added fees, season, max length, showers/wifi, booking (KOA); hookups and pull-through now manual. Site count (96, derived) not restated by KOA, left. Note cleaned of hookup/site text and renamed.
